scope: Bounded static review of installer ownership, terminal worker, process inventory, locks, path/source/evidence drift and partial application handling; inspection and independent hash/count verification of temporary-root test evidence. This is not a production deployment result.

tests.scope: Temporary target/package/datastore roots and injected process/time/claim/native maintenance gate evidence only.
tests.skips: Windows denied creating two actual symlink fixtures. Three privilege-free Windows reparse-attribute rejection cases passed.

reviewed_checks: Post-close date/time window; current exact own supervision UUID and bounded live lease; terminal matching manual session and absent saved worker PID.
Fail-closed native process inventory and competing trader/overnight process detection.
Three native maintenance-gated exclusive locks; never recover or delete an existing foreign lock; release only exact owned bytes.
Safe relative source paths, no symlink/reparse components, case-insensitive destination uniqueness and source suffix/directory scope.
Manifest, payload, base backup, changed source, supporting dependencies and combined test evidence hash bindings; repeat guards before and during writes.
Exact pre-invocation bytes captured before replacement; already-final files excluded from rollback.
Reverse rollback while all native locks remain held, including after lease expiry and post-replace exceptions; exact installed-byte ownership checked before restore/removal.
Cleanup before error evidence writes; continue other restorations after a failure; concurrent edits preserved with ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE.
Final precommit ownership/process/time/dependency/source guards are inside rollback boundary.
Post-lock-release failure records APPLIED_UNRECEIPTED and never performs unlocked rollback.

initial_finding.description: An ordinary mid-install failure previously left a mixed source tree after releasing native locks.
initial_finding.resolution: ACCEPTED: exact-owned reverse rollback was added inside all three locks, before error evidence writes, with explicit incomplete-restoration and post-release states.
initial_finding.regression_coverage: Expired claim; dependency drift; exception after atomic replacement; both restoration and new-file removal under all three locks; already-final preservation; concurrent target drift; restoration continuation; transient/persistent evidence-write failure; post-release guard and receipt-write failure.

remaining_limitations: Abrupt process termination or power loss cannot execute Python rollback; the helper does not provide whole-tree crash atomicity.
Concurrent target drift or failed restoration is deliberately preserved and may leave an incomplete source tree; this requires exact evidence-based recovery.
Post-release source or receipt failures may leave fully applied files without a valid receipt. APPLIED_UNRECEIPTED is not deployment completion.
Temporary-root tests do not prove the production process, broker, filesystem or scheduling state will be eligible at deployment time.
required_recovery_and_launch_condition: Before any trader or pipeline launch, require a fresh successful APPLIED receipt bound to this sealed package and verify all current changed-source and supporting-dependency hashes. Missing receipts, IN_PROGRESS, FILES_APPLIED_LOCKED, BLOCKED, ROLLED_BACK, ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE, APPLIED_UNRECEIPTED or abrupt loss require inspection and exact package/source/lock reconciliation, then a fresh successful apply/verification. Never infer safe launch from a partially applied source tree or stale receipt.
operational_condition_owner: Root confirms this launch/recovery condition is required by DEPLOYMENT instructions and the nightly automation prompt.
result: No further concrete blocker found in this bounded review after the accepted rollback fix. PASS is conditional on the explicit recovery and launch contract above, not a claim of production installation.
